events.title: 2026 Brisbane Anywhere Festival
events.datetime: Fri 1 May - Sun 31 May (ongoing; check for 11-17 May pop-ups)
events.source: Brisbane City Council / Anywhere Theatre Company
events.description: A month-long fringe theatre and performance festival featuring experimental, immersive shows in unconventional locations across Brisbane. This entry covers the week of May 11-17, with pop-up events including site-specific theatre, music, and storytelling.
